record.title: Independently verify the calibration contract and isolate true decision points
record.intent: Check the static graph against pinned bytes and distinguish deterministic software operations from unknown environment behavior.
requirements: Independently verify symbol ranges instruction words direct targets table extraction loop bounds output widths and loader branches against the pinned ELF; test the graph verifier with isolated altered evidence.
Account for dispatcher paths callees and unresolved edges; distinguish exact recovered operations from symbolic runtime parameters and genuinely hardware-returned or asynchronous behavior.
Identify the next externally unsatisfied dependency and the smallest coherent candidate fixture or observation needed to distinguish plausible paths, including thread coverage limits.
acceptance: Commit and push the review and bounded candidate recommendation without running a guest.
